pages.text: To get started forging, you will need a $(l:forging/tinkers_anvil)Tinker's Anvil$(), a $(l:items/tinkers_hammer)Hammer$(), and a method to heat your inputs. Make sure that the tier of your anvil is at least as high as the recipe you want to create. Anvil recipes are added by modpack scripts through CraftTweaker.
Place the heated input stack in the anvil, then hit the anvil with a hammer to forge directly.

To work an item, you first need to heat it up. Different metals have different temperatures or colors at which they become workable. You can heat up items in a $(l:temperature/charcoal_forge)Charcoal Forge$() or the $(l:temperature/brick_forge)Brick Forge$(). However, be warned: Most items will melt if they get too hot, meaning you have to watch the temperature of your items carefully.
